30: When Rabbi Meir said: Amen that I will not become defiled in the future, it did not - enter his mind that she would be evaluated [by the water] now on [events that might take place in] the future.
Will destabilize her - they will return to her throat, like a person who chokes on a liquid appears to gargle. It is the term [expressed in the verse] "they raise a cry of anguish" [Isaiah 15:5].
